record.one_liner: Vonage cloud communications APIs (SMS, voice, video, messaging, verify, numbers and more) for developers.
record.auth_notes: API key and secret sent via HTTP Basic (Authorization header) for newer APIs; JWT signed with an application private key for others. Basic with key:secret counts as api_key. Verify supports Basic and JWT. SIP Trunking uses digest with the key/secret.
record.access_notes: Sign-up creates an account with an API key and secret. The account is a free trial with restrictions: SMS only to the registered number and four verified test numbers, voice only to the registered number, trial credit cannot buy virtual numbers, and SMS is tagged with a demo prefix. Removing the restrictions requires upgrading to a paid account.
record.api_notes: Many product APIs are listed in the authentication matrix (Accounts, Application, Messages, Numbers, Media, Conversation, Verify, SIP and more). The REST style is inferred from header-based HTTP auth and product listings; no fetched page explicitly says REST, so confidence is medium.
record.blocker_notes: Self-serve trial credentials and documented APIs exist. Production sending to arbitrary numbers needs a paid account, which is a commercial step rather than a review.
